task: On Allrecipes, find a vegan brownie recipe that has at least 40 reviews and a rating of 4.5 or higher. Include the list of ingredients, total prep and cook time, and a brief overview of the preparation steps.
answer:
Found the 'Vegan Brownies' recipe on Allrecipes (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/68436/vegan-brownies/), a vegan brownie recipe with a 4.6/5 rating (meets >=4.5) and 978 ratings / 835 reviews (meets >=40).

Ingredients: 2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 cups white sugar; 0.75 cup unsweetened cocoa powder; 1 teaspoon baking powder; 1 teaspoon salt; 1 cup water; 1 cup vegetable oil; 1 teaspoon vanilla extract.

Times: Prep Time 15 mins | Cook Time 30 mins | Total Time 55 mins.

Preparation overview: (1) Gather all ingredients, preheat oven to 350°F (175°C), and grease/line a 9x13-inch baking dish. (2) Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl until combined. (3) Pour in water (or coffee), vegetable oil, and vanilla; mix until well-blended and spread batter evenly in the prepared dish. (4) Bake until the top is no longer shiny and the center feels just set when gently pressed, about 30 minutes. (5) Let cool at least 10 minutes before cutting into 15 squares.
